backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-115 policy semantics.
decision_rationale: The capped/perfect TQS bucket improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion should stay default-off metadata/helper only because Space live slots remain zero.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe; any accepted change must remain default-off metadata until forward evidence matures.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: top up only official Space candidates whose existing trade_quality_score reaches the 1.0 cap.

2_history_check.exp-20260511-012: Rejected a blanket Space trend-only filter.
2_history_check.exp-20260511-105: Accepted RKLB/ASTS launch trend 7 ATR target.
2_history_check.exp-20260511-115: Accepted a broad official-basket positive-momentum 1.10x risk scalar; this test is a distinct signal-quality bucket.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_perfect_trade_quality_score_risk_scalar; candidate pool, targets, stops, base risk, basket momentum scalar, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV regression, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, and nonzero adjusted signals.
gate_questions.5_reproducibility: This script reruns core, accepted exp-115 Space stack, and each perfect-TQS risk scalar across the canonical augmented Space snapshots.

hypothesis: Official Space signals that reach the capped trade-quality-score bucket may represent cleaner setups than the rest of the sleeve; a bounded extra risk scalar could improve EV without adding tickers, changing targets/stops, or relying on underpowered LLM soft-ranking.
interpretation: The capped/perfect TQS bucket improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion should stay default-off metadata/helper only because Space live slots remain zero.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data remains below the closed-decision gate; this run uses an existing deterministic quality-score field.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry nearby perfect-TQS Space risk scalars on the same frozen snapshots. Future Space work should use forward event replacement value or a genuinely new catalyst-quality field.
single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for official Space signals when trade_quality_score is capped at 1.0
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking and event bucket scoring are sample-limited; HAWK has no usable three-window OHLCV rows; mature satcom breadth, theme ETF timing, breakout geometry, one-slot capacity, and local Space target bucket variants have already failed.
